senses.label: Speaker-directed prominence that joins and separates subordinate and coordinate sound wholes
senses.definition: Speaker-directed prominence that joins and separates subordinate and coordinate sound wholes.
senses.rule: Distinguish this organizing accent from the intonations discussed on p407.

senses.label: The system or practice of accentuation whose living realization may not be recoverable from surviving marks
senses.definition: The system or practice of accentuation whose living realization may not be recoverable from surviving marks.
senses.rule: Preserve the time-bound claim bis jetzt rather than treating it as present-day absence.

senses.label: Graphic marks which can indicate vowel intonation as well as phenomena called accent
senses.definition: Graphic marks which can indicate vowel intonation as well as phenomena called accent.
senses.rule: A common written mark does not establish identity of the indicated sound phenomena.

senses.label: The system of articulated sounds characteristic of a language; it is not necessarily a set of written signs
senses.definition: The system of articulated sounds characteristic of a language; it is not necessarily a set of written signs.
senses.rule: Make its spoken bearer explicit when alphabet would imply script.

senses.label: Initial speech element in the authorial note contrasting word-internal and cross-word contact rules
senses.definition: Initial speech element in the authorial note contrasting word-internal and cross-word contact rules.
senses.rule: Not merely the first written character; authorial explanatory footnote, distinct from editorial deletion.

senses.label: The vivid or intuitive presentability of language’s rising construction from basic elements
senses.definition: The vivid or intuitive presentability of language’s rising construction from basic elements.
senses.rule: Do not reduce to empirical visual inspection alone.

senses.label: Actual pronunciation, in which sound quantity is grounded and by whose laws accent is constrained
senses.definition: Actual pronunciation, in which sound quantity is grounded and by whose laws accent is constrained.
senses.rule: Distinguish realized speech from written indication.

senses.label: Construction of language viewed as rising from its basic parts
senses.definition: Construction of language viewed as rising from its basic parts.
senses.rule: The architectural metaphor does not establish a fixed modern modular architecture.

senses.label: Scholarly treatment or further working of linguistic material, which may systematize as well as over-artificialize it
senses.definition: Scholarly treatment or further working of linguistic material, which may systematize as well as over-artificialize it.
senses.rule: Keep scholarly treatment distinct from spontaneous living usage.

senses.label: conceptual unity designated by the word
senses.definition: Concept receiving linguistic designation in the word, not a physical thing or the sound alone.
senses.rule: The later text further qualifies completion and individual realization.
senses.caution: Tesseract Begriii' is corrected from the image.

senses.label: Act or placement of prominence which groups adjacent syllables
senses.definition: Act or placement of prominence which groups adjacent syllables.
senses.rule: Distinguish the realizing emphasis from written Accentzeichen.

senses.label: intellectual cultivation
senses.definition: Intellectual cultivation affected by how the sequence of thoughts appears in living delivery.
senses.rule: Distinguish human cultivation from forming a word.

senses.label: Speech element situated by habitual fixation within a continuum of possible articulatory positions
senses.definition: Speech element situated by habitual fixation within a continuum of possible articulatory positions.
senses.rule: Explain its spoken bearer; the claim is not that written characters lie in the organs.

senses.label: Alphabetic writing which stabilizes analysis and transmission of sound relations without preserving the sound event itself
senses.definition: Alphabetic writing which stabilizes analysis and transmission of sound relations without preserving the sound event itself.
senses.rule: Keep the written reminder distinct from living sound.

senses.label: Alteration of adjacent speech elements under mutual influence, with a language-specific frequency and treatment
senses.definition: Alteration of adjacent speech elements under mutual influence, with a language-specific frequency and treatment.
senses.rule: Do not read as replacement of written characters.

senses.label: Change of individual speech elements used to signal conceptual distinctions
senses.definition: Change of individual speech elements used to signal conceptual distinctions.
senses.rule: The operation may serve inflection here without being synonymous with every inflection.

senses.label: Case category in the author’s note on alternate pronoun forms
senses.definition: Case category in the author’s note on alternate pronoun forms.
senses.rule: Authorial example note; no new paradigm is inferred.

senses.label: A named class of Indian speech sounds used to illustrate enlargement of an alphabet
senses.definition: A named class of Indian speech sounds used to illustrate enlargement of an alphabet.
senses.rule: Retain the historical label or explain it cautiously; no automatic modern phonetic equation.

senses.label: Consonantal speech elements whose contact can trigger changes and constrain word structure
senses.definition: Consonantal speech elements whose contact can trigger changes and constrain word structure.
senses.rule: This record preserves the source’s category without adding a modern articulatory inventory.

senses.label: Continuous range of articulatory movements out of which particular sound positions are fixed
senses.definition: Continuous range of articulatory movements out of which particular sound positions are fixed.
senses.rule: Different from a claim that a language has no sound distinctions.

senses.label: Balanced proportion of rhythm and accent
senses.definition: Balanced proportion of rhythm and accent.
senses.rule: Preserve the aesthetic evaluation.

senses.label: imaginative apprehension of speech elements
senses.definition: Imaginative faculty affected by the comparison of written signs, making speech elements clearer to the soul.
senses.rule: Do not reduce it to fanciful invention.

senses.label: Unity required on both sound and conceptual sides of a word
senses.definition: Unity required on both sound and conceptual sides of a word.
senses.rule: Keep sound-unity and concept-unity analytically distinct.

senses.label: The character of speech sounds as elements, made clearer by written signs
senses.definition: The character of speech sounds as elements, made clearer by written signs.
senses.rule: OCR Flementareigenschaft is noise, not an authorial spelling.

senses.label: Sensitivity of the senses to fine sound distinctions and contact effects
senses.definition: Sensitivity of the senses to fine sound distinctions and contact effects.
senses.rule: Distinct from an affective mood or a semantic sense.

senses.label: Characteristic manner of feeling, paired with representation as a source of living delivery
senses.definition: Characteristic manner of feeling, paired with representation as a source of living delivery.
senses.rule: Do not reduce to one momentary emotion.

senses.label: Final sound-element that may alter in anticipation of the following one
senses.definition: Final sound-element that may alter in anticipation of the following one.
senses.rule: Keep spoken contact distinct from orthographic rewriting.

senses.label: Raising of the voice in distributing discourse accent
senses.definition: Raising of the voice in distributing discourse accent.
senses.rule: Distinct lexeme from Hebung, though closely related in this context.

senses.label: Fixing/determining meanings in the language’s more inward further development
senses.definition: Fixing or determining something in a field of possibilities, here meanings; earlier a particular sound position.
senses.rule: Different bearer from physical fixation of an articulatory point.

senses.label: Inflected modifications of the root-formed word distinguished from later suffixal reshaping
senses.definition: Inflected modifications of the root-formed word distinguished from later suffixal reshaping.
senses.rule: Related to Inflexion; keep this authorial-footnote contrast visible.

senses.label: Flow metaphor connecting spoken sequencing with the movement of thought
senses.definition: Flow metaphor connecting spoken sequencing with the movement of thought.
senses.rule: Analogy does not establish identical sound and conceptual segmentation.

senses.label: grammatical or purely formal determination
senses.definition: Form used for grammatical means or formal determination, with the local contrast between a device and its effect or between formal indication and unnecessary substantive content.
senses.rule: Preserve the particular formal/material or means/effect contrast; do not identify all such uses with one later strict criterion for genuine grammatical form.
senses.caution: This is a working grouping of related uses. The source’s rankings and causal claims remain attributed, not endorsed.

senses.label: form or mode of formative activity
senses.definition: Form used for the mode or organization of mental/linguistic activity, including determinate thought and its externalization. The explicit law/direction/procedure stipulation belongs to§136.
senses.rule: Identify the operation and bearer in the local use. Keep§136’s stipulation visible without retroactively making it the exhaustive definition of every earlier Form.
senses.caution: These are grouped contextual uses of a broad form vocabulary, not a single unchanging technical doctrine. The individual source uses and their conditions remain below.

senses.label: Gradual development of languages through time, here associated with smoothing rough sounds
senses.definition: Gradual development of languages through time, here associated with smoothing rough sounds.
senses.rule: Do not turn this evaluative development into demonstrated biological evolution.

senses.label: Operation or function of language traversed by the proposed drive toward purified intellectuality
senses.definition: Operation or function of language traversed by the proposed drive toward purified intellectuality.
senses.rule: Not automatically a syntactic function label.

senses.label: Thought as a moving connected activity whose course spoken accent follows
senses.definition: Thought as a moving connected activity whose course spoken accent follows.
senses.rule: Distinguish thought/concept from the articulated sounds accompanying it.

senses.label: Expression of thought whose prominence may be affected by suppressing rhythmic quantity
senses.definition: Expression of thought whose prominence may be affected by suppressing rhythmic quantity.
senses.rule: Keep immediate conceptual emphasis separate from the full aesthetic and intellectual effects of language.

senses.label: Connection of thoughts with an emphatic contribution in delivery
senses.definition: Connection of thoughts with an emphatic contribution in delivery.
senses.rule: Distinct from sound linking by contact changes.

senses.label: intellectual agency transforming vocal sound
senses.definition: Active intellectual agency which forms and renews language; here it penetrates vocal sound and makes it articulated.
senses.rule: Do not impose a substance or blanket spiritual sense.

senses.label: independent standing in discourse
senses.definition: Independent force or standing of a word, absorbed by attachment in enclitic use.
senses.rule: Different from sensory presence or truth-validity.
senses.caution: OCR Gehung corrected from the image.

senses.label: Accompanying noise contrasted with the sound’s clear conceptual office
senses.definition: Accompanying noise contrasted with the sound’s clear conceptual office.
senses.rule: Preserve the author’s evaluative opposition; not a modern phonetic classification.

senses.label: Clear distinctness of sounds from one another, argued to affect conceptual clarity beyond preventing misunderstanding
senses.definition: Clear distinctness of sounds from one another, argued to affect conceptual clarity beyond preventing misunderstanding.
senses.rule: Distinguish a relation among sounds from their mere number.

senses.label: Nationally forming habit that assigns sounds particular positions and produces a distinctive inventory
senses.definition: Nationally forming habit that assigns sounds particular positions and produces a distinctive inventory.
senses.rule: Do not make the fixation a purely anatomical necessity.

senses.label: Division and connection of discourse into intellectual wholes, which sound alteration may clarify or obscure
senses.definition: Division and connection of discourse into intellectual wholes, which sound alteration may clarify or obscure.
senses.rule: Do not equate all Gliederung with modern syntax.

senses.label: Basic constituents distinguished in analyzing the language’s construction
senses.definition: Basic constituents distinguished in analyzing the language’s construction.
senses.rule: Do not infer a modern inventory of linguistic levels.

senses.label: Breathing or breathy vocal noise among accompanying sounds
senses.definition: Breathing or breathy vocal noise among accompanying sounds.
senses.rule: Distinct lexeme from Hauch and not evidence for one universal physiological mechanism.

senses.label: Raising of the voice in the discussion of intonation
senses.definition: Raising of the voice in the discussion of intonation.
senses.rule: Keep rise of voice distinct from the whole grammatical or conceptual role of accent.

senses.label: A word as the complete individual unit of language, contrasted with syllable and letter as elements
senses.definition: A word as the complete individual unit of language, contrasted with syllable and letter as elements.
senses.rule: Do not read as a biological organism.

senses.label: Expression of conceptual distinctions by changes of sound-elements without importing an additional material concept
senses.definition: Expression of conceptual distinctions by changes of sound-elements without importing an additional material concept.
senses.rule: Keep distinct from agglutination and composition when later enumerated.

senses.label: The intellectual character or purity of linguistic expression, affected by sound without being identical with it
senses.definition: The intellectual character or purity of linguistic expression, affected by sound without being identical with it.
senses.rule: Avoid a psychometric intelligence reading.

senses.label: Pitch variation of vowels that multiplies available sound varieties, contrasted with organizing accent
senses.definition: Pitch variation of vowels that multiplies available sound varieties, contrasted with organizing accent.
senses.rule: Do not silently identify Humboldt’s account with a modern analysis of Chinese tones.

senses.label: Short vowel quantity, completing the preceding page’s contrast with length
senses.definition: Short vowel quantity, completing the preceding page’s contrast with length.
senses.rule: Not brevity of a sentence in this occurrence.

senses.label: The language-specific handling of sounds whose relations and alterations must be understood before forms are explained
senses.definition: The language-specific handling of sounds whose relations and alterations must be understood before forms are explained.
senses.rule: Use the local sound contribution; preserve the stated contrast.

senses.label: Written designation of speech sounds as an object of scholarly treatment
senses.definition: Written designation of speech sounds as an object of scholarly treatment.
senses.rule: Distinct from choosing a concept’s lexical designation.
senses.caution: OCR l.autbezeichnungen is corrected from the image.

senses.label: Particular sound-characteristics of a language/nation contributing to differences in inventory
senses.definition: Particular sound-characteristics of a language/nation contributing to differences in inventory.
senses.rule: Do not make nationality itself a physiological explanation.

senses.label: Distinct sound realizations for a word depending on independent accent or enclitic use
senses.definition: Distinct sound realizations for a word depending on independent accent or enclitic use.
senses.rule: Keep one lexical word distinct from its different sound forms.

senses.label: Auditory wholes which may exceed the units provided by word division
senses.definition: Auditory wholes which may exceed the units provided by word division.
senses.rule: Distinguish audible grouping from word and conceptual unity.

senses.label: The audible force or realization of enclitic words altered through loss of their independent accent
senses.definition: The audible force or realization of enclitic words altered through loss of their independent accent.
senses.rule: Not logical validity.

senses.label: People-specific sound habits which govern alteration in addition to general properties of the organs
senses.definition: People-specific sound habits which govern alteration in addition to general properties of the organs.
senses.rule: Keep particular habit distinct from universally shared physiology.

senses.label: A language’s organized treatment and relations of articulated sounds, foundational for grammatical explanation and intellectual effects
senses.definition: A language’s organized treatment and relations of articulated sounds, foundational for grammatical explanation and intellectual effects.
senses.rule: Do not reduce it to written alphabet.
senses.caution: The proposed effects on intellect are Humboldt’s claims.

senses.label: Fine discrimination of sounds cultivated by language use and available for expressing conceptual distinctions
senses.definition: Fine discrimination of sounds cultivated by language use and available for expressing conceptual distinctions.
senses.rule: Keep perceptual discrimination separate from its use as a grammatical marker.

senses.label: Sound alteration which, if restricted within a word, reinforces word boundaries
senses.definition: Sound alteration which, if restricted within a word, reinforces word boundaries.
senses.rule: Do not identify cross-word alteration with intellectual combination.

senses.label: Alteration of vowel sound, including intonation changes distinguished from organizing accent
senses.definition: Alteration of vowel sound, including intonation changes distinguished from organizing accent.
senses.rule: Not necessarily historical sound change in this occurrence.

senses.label: The alternative historical label paired here with Cerebralen for an Indian sound class
senses.definition: The alternative historical label paired here with Cerebralen for an Indian sound class.
senses.rule: Keep its pairing with Cerebralen; do not infer a separate newly established class.

senses.label: Length of a vowel in the contrast with shortness, completed at the beginning of p406
senses.definition: Length of a vowel in the contrast with shortness, completed at the beginning of p406.
senses.rule: The printed page boundary interrupts the contrast; preserve the evidence boundary.

senses.label: Purification of intellectual expression by removing unnecessary sound/noise or conceptual material
senses.definition: Purification of intellectual expression by removing unnecessary sound/noise or conceptual material.
senses.rule: Retain the evaluative process; do not imply empirical improvement is established.

senses.label: Force or emphasis of spoken discourse as a result of its sound treatment
senses.definition: Force or emphasis of spoken discourse as a result of its sound treatment.
senses.rule: Do not replace by word accent in every context.

senses.label: National peculiarity invoked where the author can offer no further explanation of a habitual sound-linking practice
senses.definition: National peculiarity invoked where the author can offer no further explanation of a habitual sound-linking practice.
senses.rule: Naming it a peculiarity does not supply an independent causal mechanism.

senses.label: constitution or character
senses.definition: Constitution or character of something, here the vocal sound before intellectual articulation purifies it.
senses.rule: Distinct from Nature as a domain of objects.

senses.label: Associated concept that may mislead when unnecessary material accompanies a formal indication
senses.definition: Associated concept that may mislead when unnecessary material accompanies a formal indication.
senses.rule: Do not automatically render it connotation in every case.

senses.label: Object transformed into the speaker’s subjectivity and re-presented outwardly through the word
senses.definition: Object transformed into the speaker’s subjectivity and re-presented outwardly through the word.
senses.rule: Do not automatically equate with a mind-independent physical referent.

senses.label: Ear/hearing side of perception, paired with understanding but sensitive to rhythmic divisions
senses.definition: Ear/hearing side of perception, paired with understanding but sensitive to rhythmic divisions.
senses.rule: Do not collapse auditory requirement into a logical one.

senses.label: The bodily speech organs interacting with intellectual activity in the refinement of sound
senses.definition: The bodily speech organs interacting with intellectual activity in the refinement of sound.
senses.rule: Keep physical organs distinct from mental powers.

senses.label: Break required in intellectual or rhythmic articulation, contrasted with sound alteration running across it
senses.definition: Break required in intellectual or rhythmic articulation, contrasted with sound alteration running across it.
senses.rule: Distinguish the intellectual and auditory reasons for a break.

senses.label: Grammatical person in the explicit first-/second-person pronoun classification
senses.definition: Grammatical person in the explicit first-/second-person pronoun classification.
senses.rule: Distinct from an individual human as participant.

senses.label: Recognizable overall aspect of a word, metaphorically identified through accent
senses.definition: Recognizable overall aspect of a word, metaphorically identified through accent.
senses.rule: Keep the explicitly qualified facial metaphor.

senses.label: Pronoun category in the discussion of abbreviated versus full forms
senses.definition: Pronoun category in the discussion of abbreviated versus full forms.
senses.rule: Do not infer that the abbreviated forms are proved exclusively enclitic; the note denies that certainty.

senses.label: Physical roughness of speech organs or their sounds, distinguished from an intellectual impulse
senses.definition: Physical roughness of speech organs or their sounds, distinguished from an intellectual impulse.
senses.rule: Historical physiological speculation, not a verified biological judgement.

senses.label: Orthography as evidence by which deviations in transmitted pronunciation may be recognized
senses.definition: Orthography as evidence by which deviations in transmitted pronunciation may be recognized.
senses.rule: Orthographic evidence is not identical with living pronunciation.

senses.label: Accent varying with the nature of the discourse; its habitual treatment remains characteristic of a language
senses.definition: Accent varying with the nature of the discourse; its habitual treatment remains characteristic of a language.
senses.rule: Keep its variation in use distinct from fixed word accent.

senses.label: Speaking participant to whose intention accent belongs
senses.definition: Speaking participant to whose intention accent belongs.
senses.rule: Do not merge the lexeme with Sprechender; the roles can coincide.

senses.label: Rhythmic temporal ordering whose balance with accent may be disturbed by emphatic intellectual speech
senses.definition: Rhythmic temporal ordering whose balance with accent may be disturbed by emphatic intellectual speech.
senses.rule: Keep distinct from accent, though their treatment interacts.

senses.label: Unrefined or uncultivated condition proposed as one possible obstacle to aesthetic treatment of speech
senses.definition: Unrefined or uncultivated condition proposed as one possible obstacle to aesthetic treatment of speech.
senses.rule: Keep separate from physical Rauhigkeit and retain attribution.

senses.label: unit within discourse
senses.definition: Sentence or clause as a unit contributing weight to the meaning of discourse.
senses.rule: Choose the syntactic/discourse unit by context, not an isolated word.

senses.label: The transient acoustic occurrence to which a written sign refers
senses.definition: The transient acoustic occurrence to which a written sign refers.
senses.rule: Do not imply that writing makes the acoustic event permanent.

senses.label: Ringing/blaring vocal noise in the author’s list of sounds accompanying speech tones
senses.definition: Ringing/blaring vocal noise in the author’s list of sounds accompanying speech tones.
senses.rule: Retain as a historical perceptual label, not an exact modern segment class.

senses.label: Clicking/smacking noise named among accompanying vocal sounds
senses.definition: Clicking/smacking noise named among accompanying vocal sounds.
senses.rule: Do not silently infer a full modern account of click consonants.

senses.label: Rasping or rattling vocal noise named among accompaniments
senses.definition: Rasping or rattling vocal noise named among accompaniments.
senses.rule: No modern phonetic equivalence is established here.

senses.label: Writing introduced as a condition of further systematization of an already spoken sound inventory
senses.definition: Writing introduced as a condition of further systematization of an already spoken sound inventory.
senses.rule: Distinguish the written system from the prior sound relations.

senses.label: Written signs whose chosen precision can act back upon pronunciation and become a real possession of the speaking community
senses.definition: Written signs whose chosen precision can act back upon pronunciation and become a real possession of the speaking community.
senses.rule: A written sign is distinct from the sound whose articulation it helps fix.

senses.label: Lowering of the voice, paired with raising
senses.definition: Lowering of the voice, paired with raising.
senses.rule: Use the local prosody contribution; preserve the stated contrast.

senses.label: discriminating aptitude
senses.definition: Discriminating aptitude or sense, here for subtle sound differences.
senses.rule: Distinct from the semantic sense of a word.

senses.label: bodily sensory faculty
senses.definition: Sensory faculty of bodily perception, invoked in explaining finer sound sensitivity.
senses.rule: The associated comparison of peoples is a historical authorial claim.

senses.label: range of possible sound positions
senses.definition: Range or domain in which related positions or contents stand: a sound’s possible positions here, and a conceptual field in later use.
senses.rule: Keep range distinct from the sound fixed at one point.

senses.label: The word-level linguistic accent that can bind enclitic words rather than merely juxtaposing words through discourse accent
senses.definition: The word-level linguistic accent that can bind enclitic words rather than merely juxtaposing words through discourse accent.
senses.rule: Check its local opposition to Redeaccent rather than invent a new independent accent system.

senses.label: National dispositions in which the total sound system is said already to lie before writing refines its explicit arrangement
senses.definition: National dispositions in which the total sound system is said already to lie before writing refines its explicit arrangement.
senses.rule: Do not equate with a modern biological mechanism.

senses.label: Handling of language that can balance quantity/rhythm with accent
senses.definition: Handling of language that can balance quantity/rhythm with accent.
senses.rule: Not a named grammar method or a writing convention.

senses.label: The inward impulse toward linguistic expression whose weakness is proposed as one cause of rough sounds
senses.definition: The inward impulse toward linguistic expression whose weakness is proposed as one cause of rough sounds.
senses.rule: The causal speculation is qualified by mögen.
senses.caution: Historical evaluative speculation, not a verified physiological claim.

senses.label: Unreflective feeling for language invoked in the claim that a word’s sound should display conceptual unity
senses.definition: Unreflective feeling for language invoked in the claim that a word’s sound should display conceptual unity.
senses.rule: Do not equate with experimentally measured grammaticality judgement.

senses.label: Habitual national ways of sounding speech, distinguished from later scholarly refinement of the system
senses.definition: Habitual national ways of sounding speech, distinguished from later scholarly refinement of the system.
senses.rule: Keep distinct from the writing system.

senses.label: A true speech sound returned from noisy vocal production to its concept-stimulating role
senses.definition: A true speech sound returned from noisy vocal production to its concept-stimulating role.
senses.rule: Use the local sound contribution; preserve the stated contrast.

senses.label: The interconnected whole into which explanations of particular grammatical forms enter
senses.definition: The interconnected whole into which explanations of particular grammatical forms enter.
senses.rule: Use the local organization contribution; preserve the stated contrast.

senses.label: Speech sound whose assigned position becomes more determinate through written comparison
senses.definition: Speech sound whose assigned position becomes more determinate through written comparison.
senses.rule: Not a written sign or a mandatory musical tone.

senses.label: Investigation of language requiring complete attention to sound and the connected linguistic system
senses.definition: Investigation of language requiring complete attention to sound and the connected linguistic system.
senses.rule: A method’s evidential limits are part of the inquiry.

senses.label: The moving organs of speech which allow continuous variation in sound production
senses.definition: The moving organs of speech which allow continuous variation in sound production.
senses.rule: Preserve physical production, not an abstract communicative instrument.

senses.label: Voice as the sounded production whose rises and falls realize accentual patterns
senses.definition: Voice as the sounded production whose rises and falls realize accentual patterns.
senses.rule: Distinct from a written accent sign or conceptual weight.

senses.label: resistant material of sound formation
senses.definition: Resistant material that limits the spirit’s forming activity, here embodied sound.
senses.rule: State the local bearer rather than assuming all Stoff is acoustic.

senses.label: The subject’s inward transformation of the object, expressed outwardly by the word
senses.definition: The subject’s inward transformation of the object, expressed outwardly by the word.
senses.rule: Not mere personal bias; distinguish from objective presentation.
senses.caution: OCR Subiectivitaet corrected from the image.

senses.label: Combination of sound-elements whose permissible extent depends on a language’s restrictions
senses.definition: Combination of sound-elements whose permissible extent depends on a language’s restrictions.
senses.rule: Do not equate a syllable with a word.

senses.label: Named Sanskrit suffix class which further reshapes an already stamped word, affecting the applicable contact rules
senses.definition: Named Sanskrit suffix class which further reshapes an already stamped word, affecting the applicable contact rules.
senses.rule: Retain the historical grammatical label.
senses.caution: OCR TaddhitaSnffixen is not a spelling variant; image reads Taddhita-Suffixen.

senses.label: audible sound purified for speech
senses.definition: Audible sound which is to be separated from accompanying noise and made a true speech sound.
senses.rule: Do not assume musical pitch or lexical tone here.

senses.label: Distinct unity of sound that identifies a word whole
senses.definition: Distinct unity of sound that identifies a word whole.
senses.rule: This unity realizes rather than replaces conceptual unity.

senses.label: Accentually organized sound-domain created by beginning a new prominence
senses.definition: Accentually organized sound-domain created by beginning a new prominence.
senses.rule: Do not import a modern prosodic constituency model as an exact equivalence.

senses.label: Pattern or model of the Sanskrit sound inventory said to spread across other languages
senses.definition: Pattern or model of the Sanskrit sound inventory said to spread across other languages.
senses.rule: Not automatically an entire language’s typological class.

senses.label: Giving a root the formal status of a word; an impression/metaphor of stamping
senses.definition: Giving a root the formal status of a word; an impression/metaphor of stamping.
senses.rule: Preserve the distinction between root and formed word.
senses.caution: Authorial explanatory footnote citing Bopp; separate from the editor’s deletion note below.

senses.label: Linking several words by sound alteration and contraction across their contact
senses.definition: Linking several words by sound alteration and contraction across their contact.
senses.rule: Keep audible linking distinct from grammatical or conceptual unity.

senses.label: Running together or slurring sounds in continuous discourse, checked at pauses required by understanding
senses.definition: Running together or slurring sounds in continuous discourse, checked at pauses required by understanding.
senses.rule: Preserve the contrast between sound continuity and intellectual segmentation.

senses.label: faculty of understanding
senses.definition: Understanding as an intellectual faculty engaged in analysis, distinctions and thought, locally contrasted with other faculties such as creative imagination or synthesizing reason.
senses.rule: Prefer understanding where faculty contrasts matter. In im Verstande des Redenden the possessor identifies the speaker’s faculty; it is not the idiom in the sense.
senses.caution: Different activities of this faculty are retained as contextual uses, not counted as new lexical senses. The separate sense-of-expression idiom requires its own construction and context.

senses.label: The intellectual weight or contribution of words and syllables made more or less prominent in delivery
senses.definition: The intellectual weight or contribution of words and syllables made more or less prominent in delivery.
senses.rule: Do not conflate the compound with the faculty Verstand or with acoustic volume alone.

senses.label: The complete intellectual act of language contained in the word
senses.definition: The complete intellectual act of language contained in the word.
senses.rule: Distinct from a static sound or written object.

senses.label: Intelligibility of discourse, immediately affected by the sound system
senses.definition: Intelligibility of discourse, immediately affected by the sound system.
senses.rule: Distinguish comprehensibility from complete identity of thought.

senses.label: Vocalic sound that determines and can itself constitute a syllable
senses.definition: Vocalic sound that determines and can itself constitute a syllable.
senses.rule: Do not read as a written vowel-letter only.

senses.label: Vocalic ending bearing the Chinese intonation in the author’s explanatory note
senses.definition: Vocalic ending bearing the Chinese intonation in the author’s explanatory note.
senses.rule: This is Humboldt’s historical analysis, not newly verified Chinese phonology.

senses.label: Vowel sound considered with respect to its quantity and the inventory’s completeness
senses.definition: Vowel sound considered with respect to its quantity and the inventory’s completeness.
senses.rule: The quantity contrast continues on p406; do not complete the quotation silently.

senses.label: Living manner of spoken delivery, an element of language beyond its detached dead constituents
senses.definition: Living manner of spoken delivery, an element of language beyond its detached dead constituents.
senses.rule: Not necessarily a lecture as an institutional event.

senses.label: Reciprocal influence between the spirit’s sound formation and sound’s effects on intellectual activity
senses.definition: Reciprocal influence between the spirit’s sound formation and sound’s effects on intellectual activity.
senses.rule: Preserve both directions rather than a one-way determinism.

senses.label: Pleasing audible quality of discourse, distinguished from its intelligibility and intellectual contribution
senses.definition: Pleasing audible quality of discourse, distinguished from its intelligibility and intellectual contribution.
senses.rule: Retain its aesthetic contribution rather than treating it as mere ease of articulation.

senses.label: sound-concept linguistic individual
senses.definition: A linguistic individual uniting sound and concept; the simple word contains the complete intellectual action attributed to language.
senses.rule: Retain Worte/Wörter as observed forms without importing a dictionary-only distribution.

senses.label: Division of discourse into words as perceptible units
senses.definition: Division of discourse into words as perceptible units.
senses.rule: Not necessarily written word spacing.

senses.label: Accent belonging to the word and helping constitute it as a unit, rather than changing with the particular discourse
senses.definition: Accent belonging to the word and helping constitute it as a unit, rather than changing with the particular discourse.
senses.rule: Use the local prosody contribution; preserve the stated contrast.

senses.label: Breaks defined by words, compared with the breaks of rhythm
senses.definition: Breaks defined by words, compared with the breaks of rhythm.
senses.rule: Distinguish word boundary from metrical boundary.

senses.label: Division into words, contrasted with larger auditory grouping
senses.definition: Division into words, contrasted with larger auditory grouping.
senses.rule: Use the local segmentation contribution; preserve the stated contrast.

senses.label: Whole words regarded as units requiring their own audible unity
senses.definition: Whole words regarded as units requiring their own audible unity.
senses.rule: Preserve the unity of each word rather than a loose collection of words.

senses.label: Linking words through changes of speech elements, adding to Sanskrit’s complex sound system
senses.definition: Linking words through changes of speech elements, adding to Sanskrit’s complex sound system.
senses.rule: Use the local sound operation contribution; preserve the stated contrast.

senses.label: written reminder-sign
senses.definition: Written reminder of a speech sound.
senses.rule: Differentiate this ordinary reminder-sign from the later argument about words as signs.

senses.label: Syllabic temporal quantity, subsequently grounded in pronunciation rather than arbitrary assignment
senses.definition: Syllabic temporal quantity, subsequently grounded in pronunciation rather than arbitrary assignment.
senses.rule: Keep distinct from accent and from calendar time.

senses.label: Hissing noise named in the author’s account of accompanying sound
senses.definition: Hissing noise named in the author’s account of accompanying sound.
senses.rule: Retain the evaluative account as the author’s, not present-day acoustic classification.

senses.label: Contraction accompanying sound alteration in the linking of words
senses.definition: Contraction accompanying sound alteration in the linking of words.
senses.rule: Do not assume it produces one conceptual word.

senses.label: Non-musical, non-poetic feeling that urges complete and clear sounding of speech elements
senses.definition: Non-musical, non-poetic feeling that urges complete and clear sounding of speech elements.
senses.rule: Do not confine the aesthetic to music or verse.

senses.label: Speech sound as articulated for conceptual expression, presented as essential to language
senses.definition: Speech sound as articulated for conceptual expression, presented as essential to language.
senses.rule: Do not silently substitute phoneme or modern articulation theory.

senses.label: To designate or indicate conceptual content through a word
senses.definition: To designate or indicate conceptual content through a word.
senses.rule: Nominal Bezeichnung is a related but separate lexeme. The later text differentiates conceptual manner from sound choice.

senses.label: Attached realization opposed here to independent accent
senses.definition: Attached realization opposed here to independent accent.
senses.rule: Do not treat it merely as a writing convention.

senses.label: A separately existing word whose independent force and accent can be absorbed through attachment to another
senses.definition: A separately existing word whose independent force and accent can be absorbed through attachment to another.
senses.rule: Preserve the word’s changing sound realization and dependent use.

senses.label: Linguistic forms whose explanation depends on the language’s handling of sound
senses.definition: Linguistic forms whose explanation depends on the language’s handling of sound.
senses.rule: Keep grammatical function distinct from the sounds realizing it.

senses.label: Independently accented realization, contrasted with the enclitic realization
senses.definition: Independently accented realization, contrasted with the enclitic realization.
senses.rule: Retain the paired contrast.

senses.label: Sound-based means of making discourse units perceptibly distinct
senses.definition: Sound-based means of making discourse units perceptibly distinct.
senses.rule: The text’s adjective does not specify a modern phonetic theory.

senses.label: Dependent on choice or discretionary determination, contrasted here with quantity grounded in pronunciation
senses.definition: Dependent on choice or discretionary determination, contrasted here with quantity grounded in pronunciation.
senses.rule: Choose by context; not every occurrence means random or careless.
